CREATE TABLE "public"."ai_summary" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "generatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "highlights" json,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "modelVersion" text,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sentimentScore" float8,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "summaryText" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customer" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "firstName" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "shopifyCustomerId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" uuid,
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz,
  "email" text,
  "fulfilledAt" timestamptz,
  "fulfillmentStatus" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "shopifyOrderId" text NOT NULL,
  "shopifyOrderNumber" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_line_item" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "orderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "shopifyLineItemId" text NOT NULL,
  "sku" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "handle" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "shopifyProductId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "product_status_check_c6c4366c" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'archived', 'draft'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."review" (
  "body" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isVerifiedPurchase" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "merchantRepliedAt" timestamptz,
  "merchantReply" text,
  "orderId" uuid,
  "orderLineItemId" uuid,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reviewerEmail" text,
  "reviewerName" text,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "source" text DEFAULT 'native' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "title" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "review_source_check_f8bcd829" CHECK ("source" IN ('native', 'import', 'email_request', 'widget', 'api')),
  CONSTRAINT "review_status_check_217a058e" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'spam', 'published'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."review_media" (
  "altText" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reviewId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "thumbnailUrl" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "review_media_type_check_382e0f81" CHECK ("type" IN ('image', 'video'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."review_reply" (
  "authorName" text,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "reviewId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."review_request" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" uuid,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "openedAt" timestamptz,
  "orderId" uuid,
  "orderLineItemId" uuid,
  "productId" uuid,
  "scheduledAt" timestamptz,
  "sentAt" timestamptz,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "review_request_status_check_a0dfc826" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'sent', 'opened', 'completed', 'expired', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."shop" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text,
  "email" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "installedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "shopifyDomain" text NOT NULL,
  "shopifyShopId" text NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text,
  "uninstalledAt" timestamptz,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."shop_settings" (
  "autoPublishReviews" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "branding" json,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "emailEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "minRatingToPublish" int4 DEFAULT 4 NOT NULL,
  "requestDelayDays" int4 DEFAULT 7 NOT NULL,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "widgetEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."shopify_session" (
  "accessToken" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isOnline" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "scope" text,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "state" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sync_job" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "errorMessage" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "payload" json,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sync_job_status_check_99149439" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'running', 'completed', 'failed')),
  CONSTRAINT "sync_job_type_check_e3bcbce0" CHECK ("type" IN ('products', 'orders', 'customers', 'reviews_import', 'full_sync'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "firstName" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text,
  "role" text,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "shopifyUserId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."webhook_event" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "errorMessage" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "payload" json NOT NULL,
  "processedAt" timestamptz,
  "shopId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "shopifyWebhookId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "topic" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "webhook_event_status_check_29e2c2cd" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'processed', 'failed'))
)
